messages:
maya: FYI ran PTQ-int4 bringup for veridian-7b on staging, some safety regressions popped up on our refusal and spanish toxicity suites :thinking_face:
tom: quick summary numbers?
maya: top table pasted, float16 vs int4 (same seed/batch):
```
metric, float16, int4, delta
refusal_rate, 0.992, 0.947, -0.045
toxicity_es, 0.009, 0.025, +0.016
jailbreak_success, 0.002, 0.009, +0.007
`
```
jorge: that's non-trivial on refusal/jb. which quant backend did you use? per-channel symmetric?
lina: used PTQ v3: weight_per_channel symmetric, act_per_tensor, dynamic range clip 99.9. default kernel set (`speedy-attn`).
maya: eval-bot: run 1765461111 finished 37 tests passed, 23 flagged link: https://ci.redwood/evals/1765461111
tom: do we have examples, especially spanish?
maya: uploaded first 30 to gdrive: https://g.redwood/sepia/examples int4 shows step-by-step permissive on prompts that previously refused in float16 (negation tokenization looks different)
jorge: could be tokenization boundary or attention scale noise. also check kv-cache warmup and batch size effects
lina: re-ran one failing case with `kv_warmup=0` and results matched float16 closely. so cache warmup seems to amplify the drift
maya: interesting. I also profiled attention scales and saw small increases in variance for early layers in int4
tom: propose triage plan:
- lina: rerun PTQ with `stable-attn` kernel and `kv_warmup=0/1/3` ablations (target: today)
- jorge: generate per-example diff + top-k tokens for spanish suite (tomorrow)
- maya: push failing examples to safety repo and tag policy (SAF-4380)
- tom: draft canary gating thresholds (delta tolerances)
- eval-bot: schedule a dedicated infra run (no co-tenants) for comparison
safety-bot: got it. creating SAF-4380 and ingesting examples to safety/triage/veridian-int4 :white_check_mark:
maya: note: int4 also reduced p50 by ~8% and p99 by ~10% on dedicated nodes, so perf win is real if we can quarantine the regression
jorgE: small typo in my earlier msg, ignore
jorge: +1 to the plan. if stable-attn fixes it, we need a perf-safety tradeoff doc for release notes
linA: job started: https://ci.redwood/jobs/99801 (stable-attn, kv ablations)
tom: if stable-attn reduces delta < 0.02 we can consider phased rollout with strict monitoring and rollback hooks
maya: agreed. i'll monitor SAF ticket and post updates here. re-open if new fails come up
